Maker faire bay area 
The Future Is Handmade. Thanks for Making It With Us.
The Faire may be over, but the ideas, inspiration, and spirit of making don’t stop here. Thank you for making this year one we’ll never forget.
Maker Faire Bay Area returns to Mare Island September 24–26, 2027.
 Mark your calendar, gather your crew, start building, and come be part of it. Whether you make, invent, perform, experiment, teach, or simply love seeing what’s possible when people make things with their own hands, 
we want you back.
LOOK WHAT WE MADE TOGETHER.
What a weekend.
For three incredible days, Mare Island came alive with robots and rockets, fire and fabrication, art cars and electronics, drones and droids, handmade wonders, wild experiments, and ideas we never could have imagined on our own.
But the real magic of Maker Faire Bay Area has never been the things. 
It’s the people who make them.
To every maker who hauled in a project, answered a thousand questions, demonstrated an invention, taught someone a new skill, or shared something they made with their own two hands: thank you.
To everyone who raced a drone, soldered for the first time, pedaled for power, climbed inside a simulator, watched robots battle, wandered through glowing art, danced beside a fire-breathing octopus, or simply stopped and said, 
“Wait…how did they make that?”  
Thank you for bringing your curiosity.
And to our volunteers, crew, partners, sponsors, performers, educators, families, and the entire Maker Faire community: none of this happens without you.
This year marked 
20 years of Maker Faire Bay Area
,
two decades of bringing people together to show what they make and share what they know. Seeing Mare Island filled with makers again was a pretty great reminder of why we started doing this in the first place.
The Faire may be over, but the making doesn’t stop here.
Take something apart. Try the idea you’ve been putting off. Learn a new tool. Teach somebody what you know. Build something ridiculous. Break something. Fix it. Make it better and bring it in 2027.
Thank you for making the 20th Maker Faire Bay Area one we’ll never forget.
20th anniversary of MAKER FAIRE
WAS A weekend Packed with wonder and whimsy
We are bringing together the best of the best—from legendary makers who have been with us since the beginning to the newest innovators who are shaping the future. Maker Faire celebrates the entire creative continuum.  
Dive into a world where art, technology, and science collide.
Tech & Electronics
From humanoid robots and drones to AI-powered builds and hacks, explore Arduino and Raspberry Pi projects, wearable tech, and retro computing.
Science & engineering
Experience the power of amateur rocketry, mesmerizing Tesla coils, Rube Goldberg machines, mechanical madness and fascinating bio-hacking projects.
crafts & artisans
Sparks fly from the forge. Timber takes shape on the lathe. Fiber becomes art. And laser cutters bring digital designs to life. Witness the full spectrum of craft in action.
live & interactive
Don’t just look—play. Make a light installation dance. Chase a 
cupcake car
 along the esplanade. But make sure you are ready for  
what’s 
around the next corner.
